id: \bNot going easy.
en: \bNot going easy.
it: \bNon ci andrò piano.

id: \bYou may be able to beat Volkner.
en: \bYou may be able to beat Volkner.
it: \bForse riuscirai a battere Corrado.

id: \bLet's roll.
en: \bLet's roll.
it: \bSi parte.

id: \bSick moves man.
en: \bSick moves man.
it: \bMosse pazzesche, amico.

id: \bVolkner: Well you seem like you have some potential. Don't disappoint me, okay.
en: \bVolkner: Well you seem like you have some potential. Don't disappoint me, okay.
it: \bCorrado: Beh, sembra che tu abbia del potenziale. Non deludermi, d'accordo?

id: \bVolkner: Someone is messing with Sunnyshore Tower. We can pick up the battle after we find out what's happening.
en: \bVolkner: Someone is messing with Sunnyshore Tower. We can pick up the battle after we find out what's happening.
it: \bCorrado: Qualcuno sta facendo pasticci con la Torre di Arenipoli. Riprenderemo la lotta dopo aver scoperto cosa succede.

id: \bVolkner: Someone is tampering with Sunnyshore Tower. We need to check it out.
en: \bVolkner: Someone is tampering with Sunnyshore Tower. We need to check it out.
it: \bCorrado: Qualcuno sta manomettendo la Torre di Arenipoli. Dobbiamo andare a controllare.

id: \bVolkner: Thank you for handling the intruders. I know it took some time to fix the gym, but let's get back to our battle.
en: \bVolkner: Thank you for handling the intruders. I know it took some time to fix the gym, but let's get back to our battle.
it: \bCorrado: Grazie per esserti occupato degli intrusi. So che ci è voluto un po' per riparare la Palestra, ma riprendiamo la nostra lotta.

id: \bVolkner: You've earned the Beacon Badge.
en: \bVolkner: You've earned the Beacon Badge.
it: \bCorrado: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Faro.

id: \bHere, have this TM too.
en: \bHere, have this TM too.
it: \bEcco, prendi anche questa MT.

id: \bTM93 contains Wild Charge. A powerful electrical tackle that causes recoil.
en: \bTM93 contains Wild Charge. A powerful electrical tackle that causes recoil.
it: \bLa MT93 contiene Sprizzalampo. Una potente carica elettrica che causa danni da contraccolpo.

id: \bVolkner: I'm going to stay a gym leader for a while. Thanks for showing me there are still strong Trainers out there.
en: \bVolkner: I'm going to stay a gym leader for a while.  Thanks for showing me there are still strong Trainers out there.
it: \bCorrado: Resterò Capopalestra ancora per un po'.  Grazie per avermi mostrato che là fuori ci sono ancora Allenatori forti.

id: \bVolkner: Good to see you again. Show me once more why battles are so exciting.
en: \bVolkner: Good to see you again. Show me once more why battles are so exciting.
it: \bCorrado: Che piacere rivederti. Mostrami ancora una volta perché le lotte sono così emozionanti.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 64.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 64.
it: Rotom Phone: in base ai risultati, ora sei al posto 64 in classifica.

id: \bVolkner: Continue to train. The Master Class won't take it easy on you.
en: \bVolkner: Continue to train. The Master Class won't take it easy on you.
it: \bCorrado: Continua ad allenarti. La Classe Master non ci andrà piano con te.

id: \bHey!
en: \bHey!
it: \bEhi!

id: \bCan you beat everyone?
en: \bCan you beat everyone?
it: \bRiesci a battere tutti?

id: \bLast chance to quit.
en: \bLast chance to quit.
it: \bUltima occasione per ritirarti.

id: \bHope you beat him.
en: \bHope you beat him.
it: \bSpero che tu lo batta.

id: \bVolkner uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
en: \bVolkner uses Electric type Pokémon. They are weak aganst only the Ground type.
it: \bCorrado usa Pokémon di tipo Elettro. Sono deboli solo contro il tipo Terra.

id: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
en: \bThey are strong against Flying and Water. Flying, Electric, and Steel moves also don't do much damage.
it: \bSono forti contro Volante e Acqua. Anche le mosse Volante, Elettro e Acciaio non fanno loro molto danno.

id: \rI'm not losing.
en: \rI'm not losing.
it: \rNon perderò.

id: \rVolkner is an expert at Electric types. Use a Ground type.
en: \rVolkner is an expert at Electric types. Use a Ground type.
it: \rCorrado è un esperto del tipo Elettro. Usa un tipo Terra.

id: \rDon't think you're going to win.
en: \rDon't think you're going to win.
it: \rNon pensare di vincere.

id: \rVolker will beat you. He beats everyone.
en: \rVolker will beat you. He beats everyone.
it: \rCorrado ti batterà. Batte tutti.
